UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences, Celigo API tokens, GChat webhook URL, Gmail recipients, and customizable message alert templates

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owning these settings

email.description: Email address of the authenticated Gappify user

gmailDefaultRecipients.description: Comma-separated default recipient email addresses for incident alerts

gchatMessageTemplate.description: Customizable template for Google Chat card and text alerts

gmailSubjectTemplate.description: Customizable subject template for Gmail incident notification emails

gmailBodyTemplate.description: Customizable body HTML template for Gmail incident notification emails

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last settings update

CeligoJiraLink.title: CeligoJiraLink
CeligoJiraLink.description: Persistent mapping between Celigo error records and created or linked Jira GS tickets

errorId.description: Unique identifier of the Celigo error

jiraTicketUrl.description: Direct URL link to Jira ticket in Atlassian

status.description: Current status of the Jira ticket (e.g. To Do, In Progress, Done)

assigneeName.description: Assigned engineer or support team member

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when ticket link was created

linkedBy.description: User email or UID who created or linked the ticket

CeligoSyncSnapshot.title: CeligoSyncSnapshot
CeligoSyncSnapshot.description: Historical Celigo integration health and error volume snapshot for statistics and trend analysis

epochMs.description: Numeric epoch millisecond timestamp for sorting and time ranges

resolvedErrors.description: Count of resolved errors in this period

healthyFlowsCount.description: Count of flows with zero errors

linkedJiraCount.description: Number of active errors linked to Jira tickets

PushSubscription.title: PushSubscription
PushSubscription.description: Web push endpoint and cryptographic keys registered for 24/7 background OS alerts

/user_settings/{userId}.description: Stores user-scoped settings, tokens, GChat hooks, Gmail recipients, and notification templates for cross-device synchronization

/celigo_jira_links/{errorId}.description: Persistent mapping between Celigo errors and Jira tickets to prevent ticket loss across syncs

/celigo_sync_history/{snapshotId}.description: Historical Celigo health snapshots for analytics, MTTR calculations, and trend reporting

/push_subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.description: Stores device push subscriptions for 24/7 background notifications
